source: Petroleum Planning & Analysis Cell (PPAC), Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas, Government of India
note: Delhi retail petrol/diesel prices are revised infrequently rather than daily. PPAC's own daily bulletin shows both prices flat for at least 96 consecutive days up to the fetch date above. PPAC publishes no machine-readable API or downloadable CSV for this series — only a same-day-dated PDF bulletin at the source page above, whose filename changes daily and isn't predictable in advance. Refresh this file by hand: open the source page, download that day's 'RSP of Petrol and Diesel' PDF, and update the four price/date fields. There is no automated fetch script for this reason (see fetch-weather.mjs for a source that does have a clean API).
